package.name: openral_hal_lunar_bot
package.description: OpenRAL HAL lifecycle node for the lunar_bot embodiment (4WIS/4WID rover chassis + 7-DoF RealMan RM-75 arm + EG2-4C2 gripper). Wraps LunarBotSRBHAL (from openral-hal) as a ROS 2 managed lifecycle node that bridges the safety-checked chunk path to Space Robotics Bench (SRB), an externally-owned Isaac Sim simulator reached over ROS 2 — not OpenRAL's own in-process physics, hence a bespoke transport-attach subclass (openral_hal.lifecycle.ManifestHALLifecycleNode) rather than the generic per-robot lifecycle_node wrapper. First integration slice: BODY_TWIST only — publishes geometry_msgs/Twist on SRB's .../action/cmd_vel, subscribes sensor_msgs/JointState from SRB's .../robot/joint_states and republishes it on the standard /joint_states topic. Subscribes /openral/safe_action and /openral/estop via the shared lifecycle base.
